title: Pipe saddle
about: A block that holds a 22 mm pipe or rod on a wall or bench: a half-round channel cut across its top, and a screw hole through each side. The channel is a circle sketched on the front face, centered on the top edge, and cut back through the block.
picture_alt: A block with a half-round channel across its top and a screw hole on each side
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=BlockSketch kind=length on=Line1 value=50 name=Width
sketch.constrain sketch=BlockSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=20 name=Depth
sketch.constrain sketch=ChannelSketch kind=radius on=Circle1 value=11 name=Pipe

change.about: fit a 25 mm pipe: make the channel's radius 12.5 mm instead of 11 mm (ChannelSketch's Pipe). The screw holes stay in the flanges.
